title: Narrative Writing
titleMy: ဖြစ်စဉ်ဖော်ပြသော စာရေးသားခြင်း
description: A past-tense story about a day by the sea; keep the tempo rising gently toward the last happy line.

exercises.instruction: Type the story top to bottom without stopping; smoothness matters more than speed.
exercises.text: Last summer, my family visited a small town by the sea. We woke up early to watch the fishermen pull in their boats. I collected bright shells on the sand. It was the happiest day of my year.
